thread:
Alex Chen: quick handoff — TL;DR: we had intermittent 429s and elevated tail latency from the kv-cache pool in eu-west-1 earlier this evening. Pager came in around ~02:08 UTC and the incident bot created INC-2026-0421. No customer data lost; some requests retried and experienced increased latency.

Maya Patel: adding context — a burst of long prefix queries from a single customer triggered cache eviction storms. We saw the batcher queue spike and a couple of agents OOM’ing briefly. Root cause still under investigation but likely workload pattern + cache pressure.

Samir Khan: actions taken so far:
- disabled model-variant `vllm-qa-beta` on eu-west to reduce concurrent KV pressure
- lowered per-worker batch_size from 64 -> 32 (temporary)
- enabled stricter per-token rate limit for the affected API key (customer P-42)
- triggered autoscale scale-up x2 for the dedicated eu-west pool (manual)
All changes deployed at ~02:25 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421 created by oncall at 1845007200. Severity: S2. Pages: 4. Links: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-0421

Alex Chen: current status: kv-cache tail latency is back to baseline for most routes, 429s dropped by ~92% after throttling and disabling variant. A few customers still seeing occasional 429s on long-context generation paths.

Jordan Lee: i can take primary for the overnight shift. I'll keep an eye on autoscale and batcher queues. Maya, can you confirm any follow-ups you want applied before you sign off?

Maya Patel: I'm stepping out in ~20m (family thing). Followups: please keep the extra autoscale active for another 2h, run the cache-eviction report, and don't re-enable the beta variant until Monday after we complete the workload replay. Also, add P-42 to the blacklist for long-prefix queries temporarily.

Samir Khan: noted. I'll schedule the cache-eviction report now:
```
./tools/eviction_report --cluster eu-west-1 --since "2h" --out /tmp/eviction-report.json
cat /tmp/eviction-report.json | jq '.top_keys[0:10]'
```
Will paste results into the incident doc when done.

Jordan Lee: good. Who's secondary? I can take primary; Samir can be secondary unless Alex wants to stay on-call.

Alex Chen: I'm happy to be secondary for the next 3h. If the pager fires, ping me and Samir in that order.

Maya Patel: I pushed a quick runbook note here: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/kv-cache-throttle — FYI the recommended mitigation is dropdown + per-key rate limits + temporary variant disable.

Samir Khan: eviction report uploaded to the incident doc. top offenders look like one keyspace with ~1.2M unique prefixes over 1h. I'll start a replay job to try to reproduce and catch the exact eviction pattern.

Jordan Lee: monitoring checklist for overnight:
- watch batcher queue metrics (batcher.queue_length)
- watch cache miss ratio and tail latency (kv.cache_tail_p95/p99)
- watch autoscale events and node readiness in eu-west
- watch for recurrent pages from P-42 or similar keys
Set alerts to page on p99 latency > 300ms or 20% 429s for >5m.

Alex Chen: I also added a temporary alert suppression rule for noisy internal noise on deploys to avoid duplicate pages. Keep me looped if suppression hides anything critical.

Maya Patel: quick note for postmortem — capture: what customer query pattern caused the churn, why the variant increased KV pressure (memory layout?), and why autoscale didn't smooth it earlier. Assign to Sarah for deep-dive (she's morning shift).

Samir Khan: created a follow-up ticket: RDW-5432 "kv-cache eviction replay and variant memory profile" and linked it to the incident.

Jordan Lee: next steps for tonight (actionable):
1) Keep autoscale x2 for eu-west for at least 2h.
2) Do not re-enable `vllm-qa-beta`.
3) Monitor and escalate to Alex if pages > 2 in an hour.
4) Samir to attach reproduction logs to RDW-5432.
5) Maya to file the initial incident notes and assign postmortem owner (Sarah).

Alex Chen: thanks team. I'll stay available as backup until 06:00 UTC. Jordan — please drop a short handoff note in the morning summarizing any after-hours activity.

Jordan Lee: will do. marking primary: Jordan Lee, secondary: Alex Chen, backup: Samir Khan. Signing on now. Good handoff. :thumbsup:

Maya Patel: thanks all — tagging incident-bot to add to daily incident rollup.

incident-bot: INC-2026-0421 appended to daily rollup.

Samir Khan: one more quick snippet — logs from the peak (grep):
```
[02:11:23] WARN batcher: queue_len=812, avg_wait_ms=1200
[02:12:07] ERROR kv: eviction:95% free_mem=120MB keyspace=customer:P-42/prefix
[02:13:01] WARN api: 429 path=/v1/generate key=P-42
```

Jordan Lee: copied. I'll stay watchful and ping if anything else crops up. Good handoff, everyone.
